entries.27d2fad6ff611379: This business manufactures and sells reels, rods and fishing gear. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, revenue from external customers was ¥110,832 million (up 5.6% year on year). Manufacturing is carried out by the company, its subsidiaries in Malaysia and China (Kunshan), Shimano Kumamoto Co., Ltd. and others, and sales are carried out by the company and its sales subsidiaries in Europe and North America, among others. Sales were firm, centered on overseas markets, and the spinning reel “STELLA SW” and baitcasting reel “ANTARES” were well received.

entries.f12c0e35a9b91361: The group's central business, making and selling drive components such as derailleurs, braking components such as brakes, and other bicycle components and related products. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥354,972 million (up 2.7% from the previous fiscal year), accounting for most of consolidated net sales of ¥466,243 million. Subsidiaries in Singapore, Malaysia, China (Kunshan and Tianjin) and elsewhere, together with the company, manufacture and sell, and sales subsidiaries in Europe and North America sell to some customers. The top-end model for mountain bikes "XTR" and "Q'AUTO", with a self-powered automatic shifting function, were well received.
